summary: Frontend-only i18n verification of the V2 landing page for 4 target languages (es, fr, de, ja) plus English baseline. All 6 refactored landing-v2 components (PricingV2, FAQV2, FooterV2, ClosingCTAV2, InvestorSectionV2, LandingModal) render correct localized copy across languages. Language persistence, Early Access modal (Spanish), Investor form (Spanish), and Pricing pre-checkout email modal (Spanish) all verified. No i18next / missingKey console warnings observed.

critical_code_review_comments: Investor form label 'labelEmail' is used in both LandingModal and InvestorSectionV2 — fine, but note the localized string is just 'Email' in ES which is arguably OK (universally understood). If Correo is desired per task spec ('Correo'), consider updating v2Landing.modal.labelEmail and v2Landing.investor.labelEmail in es.json — the spec explicitly listed 'Correo'. Currently renders as 'Email' (see investor_es_sample). Same for de/fr/ja/pt-BR — consider whether this is intentional.

Honeypot label 'Website (leave blank)' is hardcoded English string in InvestorSectionV2.jsx (line 429). Since it's visually/aria hidden it has no user impact, but strictly speaking it is untranslated. Low priority.

PricingV2.jsx line 260 uses double `data-testid={pricing-cta-${tier.slug}}` — the same testid appears twice (lines 228 and 237) in conditional branches; only one is rendered at a time so it's fine, but flag for consistency.
seed_data_creation: None — no forms submitted (avoided DB pollution per instructions)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All landing-v2 i18n keys resolve correctly for en/es/fr/de/ja. Locale JSON structure has v2Landing namespace with subsections: hero, timeline, workingProduct, signal, features, device, audiences, roadmap, founder, investor, pricing, faq, closing (NOT closingCTA), footer, modal. Note key is 'closing' not 'closingCTA' — component uses v2Landing.closing.closer for the tagline. Test verified 4 languages against expected strings; other 7 languages (ar, hi, it, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-CN) were not spot-checked but auto-translation script produced identical schema (317 keys per file). If issues arise for a specific language, first verify the corresponding key in that locale JSON.
